text:
maria: quick triage note — CVE-2026-2101 (openssl libssl) affects our onprem/priv images built from base-image-v2. Customers that pin images are potentially impacted. Need backport prioritization for Dedicated + Private (VPC + on‑prem).

maria: severity is HIGH (remote code execution vector on TLS handshake). exploitability seems realistic based on PoC in the wild.

aaron: +1, ran quick dependency scan against customer images list — 7 distinct customers using the vulnerable layer, 3 are air-gapped with manual image import workflows.

jen: for air-gapped ones we can't do in-place rotation of KMS keys remotely. We'll need to produce patched images (signed) and coordinate SRE + customer to import. timeline depends on each customer's change window.

kai: rollout constraints: Dedicated reserved pools we can replace in-place with rolling drains; Private onprem has 2 classes: (1) customer-managed images where we hand over artifacts, (2) full-managed installs where we push via our updater. Both need backport artifacts.

maria: proposal: create a priority matrix (Impact / Exposure / Effort) and map customers + internal tiers. high-impact + low-effort => immediate backport and canary. medium-impact + high-effort => schedule next week. low-impact => monitor and plan for next minor.

derek: agree. Suggest tags/branches naming convention so ops can find the right image: `backport/cve-2026-2101/<target>-<semver>` e.g. `backport/cve-2026-2101/customer-image-1-2026.1`

maria: exact. also need clear changelog and SBOM for compliance. add `SBOM: true` label to image metadata.

jen: KMS note — some customers use HSM-backed KMS; key rotation requires on-site admin for export/import. I'll add per-customer KMS playbook entries.

aaron: we should avoid creating new long-lived forks for every customer. Plan: main backport branch per major base-image + customer-patch overlays. Example git layout:```
repo: customer-images
branches:
  backport/cve-2026-2101/base-v2
  overlays/customer-123
```
Keep overlays lightweight.

kai: infra/runbook ops: for Dedicated we can do canary on staging pool, monitor latency/errors for 24h, rollback policy if >0.5% 5xx. For Private full-managed installs, do staged email + wg with customer.

maria: owners? I can own coordination with security/customer-notify. Derek can own image builds and branch hygiene. Jen owns KMS/runbooks. Kai owns rollout automation + monitoring. Aaron will do impact mapping + SBOMs.

maria: action items (short):
- `derek` create `backport/cve-2026-2101/base-v2` and publish candidate images (tag + SBOM) by EOD tomorrow.
- `aaron` finish customer exposure matrix (csv) and attach to thread.
- `jen` draft KMS import playbooks for air-gapped/HSM customers.
- `kai` prepare canary automation plan and alerting thresholds.

derek: ack — starting build CI job now. snippet for image build:```
docker build -t registry.redwood.dev/customer-images:backport-cve-2026-2101-basev2 .
docker push registry.redwood.dev/customer-images:backport-cve-2026-2101-basev2
```
I will also add `sha256` and attach SBOM link to the release.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] CI job `image-backport/cve-2026-2101` queued by derek — run #1 started (logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/jobs/12345).

maria: thanks. once we have the first candidate, we'll pick 2 Dedicated pools for canary and reach out to 3 high-risk customers for early import window. i'll post the customer-facing note draft here for review when ready. :thumbsup:
